title: A withheld test check, or a report refused with its evidence, leaves no reason anywhere but the host's stderr
outcome:
Reported by Engram::Opus (2026-09-27, mailbox #331-#332) for session-7284.
Two turns ran host-observed tests, and each left a turn observation in Engram but no verification evidence of any kind:
- Turn one, about 20:46:30-20:50:00Z: run 01a0e391, cargo test --lib -q, 1090 passed in 116 s.
- Turn two, 20:50:05-20:51:42Z: run 01a0e397 (grant 01a0e4a1), cargo test --lib -q <one test>, 1 passed.
Both were in the Claude Bash tool, foreground, with cwd the main Engram checkout (workdir \?\C:\github\Personal\Engram). The checkpoint cards show grant / sent_on_grant with nothing about checks.

Two TermAl mechanisms give exactly this result, and both are only eprintln'd to the host's stderr:
(1) engram_resolve_turn_checks (src/engram_turn_checks.rs ~370) withholds a check whose start and end snapshots differ, meaning the source moved while it ran. Other writable sessions working in the same main checkout during the run would cause it.
(2) engram_turn_report's fallback: when Engram refuses a report that carries evidence (a redacted summary, a bounds or basis mismatch), TermAl sends the report without checks.
Neither reason reaches the session, the checkpoint card, or Engram. The live host has no log file (~/.termal holds none), so after the fact the cause cannot be recovered from here. The agent is left guessing and may rerun tests blindly.
Fix direction: record the withheld or fallback reason where it can be read. Options: on the checkpoint card, for example 'check withheld: source changed during the run' or 'evidence refused by Engram: <code>'; in the turn report as an indeterminate observation, if Engram's contract allows one; or both. Also consider a durable host log.
Related: tm-5gi4 phase 2, where a claim's named source root measures checks in the item's own worktree, avoiding case (1) from other sessions' writes to the main checkout.
disposal_reason: Superseded by w-3e6804fa2785 (PI-7): 99d262e landed the one-call form and the host lines for a recognised test that gets no check (hypothesis 4; evidence in note 93fe68ccf39a4b9ca03ca7716a0996a8); the outcome's two remaining paths — a check withheld at resolution because its snapshots differ, and a report refused with its evidence — are the silent no-credit paths that w-3e6804fa2785 delivers, together with w-9ebadc01e428 (overlap marking) and w-32d02e1dd7f6 (place outside the worktree).
